description: Add unit/render tests for the leaderboard components (client, currently 0% coverage - the L-prerequisite coverage gate). Primary target: BaseLeaderboard.tsx (pure presentational, depends only on useTheme). Extend to the per-game wrappers as sensible. ADDITIVE test files only - must NOT require changing any component under test. Independent of FEAT-001/002/004.
steps: Create packages/client/src/components/game/__tests__/BaseLeaderboard.test.tsx. Render BaseLeaderboard inside the theme provider: `import { ThemeProvider } from '../../../theme'` and wrap with `<ThemeProvider themeId="retro-casino">...</ThemeProvider>` (confirm the valid theme id by reading packages/client/src/theme/themes.ts / index.ts; DEFAULT_THEME is exported). Use @testing-library/react `render`/`screen` (pattern: see packages/client/src/games/playcaller/__tests__/PlaycallerComponents.test.tsx).

Build a helper that returns GameLeaderboardEntry[] fixtures (fields: playerId, playerName, rank, score, and optional streak/coldStreak). Cover these behaviors of BaseLeaderboard (read BaseLeaderboard.tsx for exact rendered output): (1) renders one row per entry with playerName and score text; (2) rank badges - each entry.rank is rendered (the RankBadge shows the numeric rank; ranks 1/2/3 get distinct theme badge classes vs default - assert the rank number text appears for several ranks); (3) current-player highlight - when an entry.playerId === currentPlayerId, that row shows the '(you)' suffix (assert screen.getByText content includes '(you)' for the current player and that non-current rows do not); (4) empty state - entries=[] renders nothing (component returns null; assert container has no list items); (5) slot rendering - passing renderRow, renderScore, renderHeader renders their output (e.g. render a recognizable test node via each slot and assert it is in the document; note renderRow and renderScore are suppressed in compact variant, renderHeader is not); (6) compact variant - variant='compact' still renders rows but suppresses renderRow/renderScore slot content (assert a renderRow test node is absent when variant='compact' but present in default); (7) streak indicator - entry with streak>=3 shows the fire indicator, coldStreak>=2 shows ice (assert the emoji text appears). Assertions must be concrete (specific text/roles), not trivially-true.

Extend to the per-game wrappers where practical. These wrappers (CoinTossLeaderboard, BigWheelLeaderboard, PlaycallerLeaderboard, and components/game/GameLeaderboard.tsx) read from useGameStore (zustand, packages/client/src/store/useGameStore.ts) and some use useDeferredRevealValue. To test a wrapper, set store state via useGameStore.setState(...) (or the store's documented API - inspect useGameStore.ts) with a roomState containing gameLeaderboard + playerId, wrap in ThemeProvider, render, and assert the rows/pts render. Prioritize GameLeaderboard.tsx (simplest: reads roomState.gameLeaderboard + playerId, renders rank/name/score 'pts', current-player highlight) and at least one BaseLeaderboard-backed wrapper (e.g. CoinTossLeaderboard) to prove the slot wiring. If a wrapper's store/hook setup proves impractical in a unit test, cover BaseLeaderboard thoroughly (the required minimum) and note the wrapper limitation in findings rather than forcing a source change.

If any test appears to require modifying a component (BaseLeaderboard or a wrapper) to pass, STOP and record it in findings - do NOT change the component. The tests are additive and lock in current behavior.
Run the new tests and the full client suite; confirm the new leaderboard tests pass and no previously-passing client test regressed.
acceptance_criteria: packages/client/src/components/game/__tests__/BaseLeaderboard.test.tsx exists and passes, covering: row rendering, rank badges, current-player highlight, empty state, renderRow/renderScore/renderHeader slots, compact variant, and streak indicators.

At least one per-game wrapper (e.g. GameLeaderboard and/or CoinTossLeaderboard) has a passing render test driven via useGameStore state, OR a documented finding explains why a specific wrapper could not be unit-tested without a source change.
All new leaderboard tests pass under `unset NODE_OPTIONS && pnpm --filter @games-of-chance/client test`.
No component under test (BaseLeaderboard.tsx or any wrapper) was modified - additive test files only.
Assertions are concrete (specific text/role/class checks), not trivially-true.
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && pnpm --filter @games-of-chance/client test (full client suite - confirm no regression, new tests pass)
git diff --stat (confirm only new test files added under client, no component source changed)
findings: Added packages/client/src/components/game/__tests__/BaseLeaderboard.test.tsx (13 tests, all passing). Coverage: (1) one row per entry with playerName + score text; (2) numeric rank badge rendered for each entry; (3) ranks 1/2/3 get distinct badge classes vs default (rank 4) and each other; (4) current-player '(you)' suffix present only on the current row; (5) empty entries renders nothing (component returns null, no <li>, empty textContent); (6) renderHeader/renderRow/renderScore slots render in default variant; (7) compact variant suppresses renderRow+renderScore but keeps renderHeader and still renders rows; (8) streak indicators 🔥🔥 (streak>=3), 🔥 (streak===2), 🧊🧊 (coldStreak>=3), 🧊 (coldStreak===2). Wrappers covered: GameLeaderboard (store-driven via useGameStore.setState, no theme needed - asserts rank/name/'<score> pts'/'(you)' highlight + null on no-room and empty-leaderboard) and CoinTossLeaderboard (BaseLeaderboard-backed, wrapped in ThemeProvider retro-casino, proves slot wiring: rows + 'Flips:' header slot + '(you)' + null on empty). CoinTossLeaderboard is testable because round.phase='PICKING' makes useDeferredRevealValue return the live value, so store-provided gameLeaderboard/tossHistory show immediately. No component under test modified - additive test files only. Full client suite: 210 passed, only the 4 documented pre-existing failures remain (field-utils.property.test.ts x1, ReplayBattleArena.test.tsx x3); my new tests add zero regressions. NOTE: an unrelated untracked dir packages/server/src/scoring/__tests__/ exists (not part of FEAT-003 / another feature's work) and was intentionally NOT staged.
